title: Contact Center Voice AI: Low-Latency Intelligence Extraction from Messy Audio Streams — Dippu Singh
talk_summary: A Fujitsu architect describes a four-stage contact-center pipeline (voice capture, STT, LLM summarization/extraction, CRM sync) that cuts after-call work from 6.3 to 3.1 minutes. The transferable parts are structured-output prompting, a verification gate before automated writes, and early PII masking; the rest is telephony/audio-specific.

takeaways.technique: Schema-constrained structured output instead of free-form summaries
takeaways.what_they_do: Instead of asking the LLM to 'summarize', they use few-shot templates that force separate bullet lists (customer inquiry vs operator action) and a final strict JSON schema matching CRM fields, so output is database-ready rather than a narrative paragraph.
takeaways.evidence_quote: if you just ask an LLM to summarize a call, it outputs a messy narrative paragraph. So instead, we use few-shot libraries

takeaways.technique: Reasoning layer that must justify its classification
takeaways.what_they_do: They give the LLM a predefined closed list of call reasons and require it to output the chosen class plus the reason it chose it, rather than open-ended labeling.
takeaways.evidence_quote: instruct it to classify the transcript and output the reason why it chose that specific classification

takeaways.technique: Automated hallucination/grounding check before accepting output
takeaways.what_they_do: A 'trust layer' runs automated hallucination checks to ensure the generated summary is grounded in the transcript, plus token optimization to keep latency low.
takeaways.evidence_quote: runs the uh automated hallucination checks to ensure the uh generated summary is strict um and it is grounded in the transcript

takeaways.technique: Human verification gate before automated writes
takeaways.what_they_do: They do not remove the human: the operator sees the AI-populated summary, does a quick visual field validation, edits if needed, then confirms before data syncs to the CRM.
takeaways.evidence_quote: We use a verification step in between. Uh the operator, it sees the AI-generated summary auto-populated

takeaways.technique: Early-stage PII masking before data reaches the model
takeaways.evidence_quote: early-stage PII masking technique uh so that the sensitive data it never hits the LLM memory banks

takeaways.what_they_do: They explicitly call out token optimization as a continuous effort because running complex reasoning over long transcripts is the main cost driver, and they flag it as an ongoing constraint.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we are constantly working on token optimization techniques to bring this number down
